invariant.claim_to_evidence: Every claim atom MUST be supported by at least one admitted evidence atom.
invariant.evidence_to_scope: Every scope atom exercised by admitted evidence MUST belong to the active epoch authorization set.
invariant.cardinality_warning: |C| and |E| alone do not establish set inclusion; support and scope bindings are explicit relations.

historical_authority.rule: A token is active only in the epoch for which it was issued.

GOVANA.mechanism: OPA/Rego policy decision plus epoch binding

JIREH.mechanism: claim/evidence binding with optional runtime telemetry adapter

lean_proves: stale epoch tokens are unauthorized under the epoch-equality model
